stem: At same-day pickup, a pharmacy trains new hires on CQI but has provided no follow-up education to existing personnel for 18 months. What is required?

choices.text: Train personnel only when they are first hired.
Repeat training every two years with license renewal.
Educate pharmacists only, excluding other pharmacy personnel.
Substitute two hours of pharmacist law CE for the pharmacy's CQI program education.
Provide ongoing CQI education to pharmacy personnel at least annually.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'Provide ongoing CQI education to pharmacy personnel at least annually.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Train personnel only when they are first hired.' would require that ongoing CQI education were not required. The decisive cue appears in 'At same-day pickup, a pharmacy trains new hires on CQI but has provided no follow-up education to existing personnel for 18 months. What is required?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Train personnel only when they are first hired.' would apply only if ongoing CQI education were not required; 'At same-day pickup, a pharmacy trains new hires on CQI but has provided no follow-up education to existing personnel for 18 months. What is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Repeat training every two years with license renewal.' would apply only if the regulation used a biennial rather than annual interval; 'At same-day pickup, a pharmacy trains new hires on CQI but has provided no follow-up education to existing personnel for 18 months. What is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.C: 'Educate pharmacists only, excluding other pharmacy personnel.' would apply only if the CQI education duty did not extend across pharmacy personnel; 'At same-day pickup, a pharmacy trains new hires on CQI but has provided no follow-up education to existing personnel for 18 months. What is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.D: 'Substitute two hours of pharmacist law CE for the pharmacy's CQI program education.' would apply only if individual CE automatically met the facility's separate annual duty; 'At same-day pickup, a pharmacy trains new hires on CQI but has provided no follow-up education to existing personnel for 18 months. What is required?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.E: 'Provide ongoing CQI education to pharmacy personnel at least annually.': supported by cqi education.

related_facts: A pharmacy's CQI program must provide ongoing education in continuous quality improvement to pharmacy personnel at least annually.
